title: A third-medium approach for electro-thermo-mechanical contact considering Joule heating
summary: Connectors are ubiquitous in technical systems and frequently combine mechanical contact with electric current transfer and heat generation. To capture these interacting processes, an electro-thermo-mechanical contact formulation based on the third-medium concept is proposed. Mechanical contact, electric current flow, and heat conduction are represented within a unified finite element framework without explicit contact-surface tracking.
